topic: Characteristics of the Indian Economy & Development

items.front: Economic growth vs economic development — the key difference?
items.back: Growth = quantitative rise in real per-capita income. Development = growth + lower poverty/inequality/unemployment + welfare (broader).

items.front: Current GVA shares of the three sectors in India (approx)?
items.examPoint: Sectoral GVA share vs workforce share (current data)

items.front: Why is India's agriculture sector marked by low productivity?
items.back: Workforce share ~44–46% but GVA share only ~18% — the wide gap signals low output-per-worker and disguised unemployment.

items.front: State the four national-income identities linking GDP, GNP, NNP, NDP.
items.back: GNP = GDP + NFIA; NDP = GDP − Depreciation; NNP = GNP − Depreciation; NNP at factor cost = National Income.
items.examPoint: National income aggregates — GDP, GNP, NNP, NDP

items.back: Factor cost = Market price − Indirect taxes + Subsidies.
items.examPoint: GNP = GDP + NFIA; market price vs factor cost

items.front: GDP deflator formula and India's base year?
items.back: Deflator = (Nominal GDP ÷ Real GDP) × 100; base year 2022-23 (new series from Feb 2026, replacing 2011-12).
items.examPoint: Nominal vs real GDP & GDP deflator

items.front: The three methods of estimating national income?
items.examPoint: GVA & three methods of national income estimation

items.front: HDI — dimensions, publisher, and India's HDR 2025 standing?
items.back: Health + Education + Standard of living (GNI pc); UNDP; India 0.685, rank 130/193 (Medium).

items.back: Justice M. B. Shah; formed May 2014 on a Supreme Court direction to trace undisclosed domestic/foreign wealth.

items.front: PMLA 2002 — enforcing agency and the three laundering stages?
items.back: Enforcement Directorate (ED); Placement → Layering → Integration; FIU-IND gets suspicious-transaction reports.

items.front: Which 2015 law targets undisclosed foreign income and assets?
items.back: Black Money (Undisclosed Foreign Income and Assets) and Imposition of Tax Act, 2015.

items.front: AP economy: GSDP, per-capita income, and how its GSVA differs from all-India?
items.back: GSDP ~₹19.75 lakh cr (2026-27); per-capita ~₹2.98 lakh (above national); primary sector ~35–37% of GSVA (vs ~18% all-India).
items.examPoint: Andhra Pradesh GSDP & per-capita income (latest) — ~₹19.75 lakh cr, ~₹2.98 lakh per capita
